flawed_step: Step 1 (the n = 3 base case) cannot be justified: the claimed upper bound is (5·3 - 10)/3 = 5/3 edges.
counterexample: The triangle C3 is connected, planar, simple, has n = 3 vertices, contains a cycle, and has 3 > 5/3 edges.
assessment_summary: The statement already fails at the smallest permitted value n = 3.
